title: Dallas launches new resource page ahead of FIFA World Cup
summary: The website can be translated into more than 200 languages to accommodate international visitors.

title: Sen. Mark Warner to introduce bill to restore MS-ISAC funding, boosting federal cyber support to $50M annually
summary: Warner's bill would authorize $50 million annually for the MS-ISAC, doubling the federal government's investment.

title: Markle Foundation initiative aims to bring practical AI tools to emergency management
summary: Rather than developing new AI models, the AIDE initiative focuses on developing practical ways the technology can support state and local emergency managers before, during and after disasters.

title: House subcommittee splits on SECURE Data Act that preempts state privacy laws
summary: Members of the House Energy and Commerce Committee divided down party lines over the SECURE Data Act that would preempt almost all state privacy laws.

title: Illinois hires its first chief AI officer
summary: As Illinois' first chief AI officer, Sakkaria will lead the department's enterprise AI strategy and support the state's responsible adoption of artificial intelligence.

title: Houston launches AI pilot to improve curb management, make loading zones safer
summary: The 18-month Smart Loading Zone pilot, which began Tuesday, introduces sensor-equipped loading zones in downtown and midtown Houston.

title: Maryland’s new AI Innovation Lab to help state agencies adopt, experiment with tech
summary: The new lab will give state agencies access to a controlled sandbox environment for securely testing AI tools.

title: Former California technology leader Amy Tong to lead new AI working group at Ballard Partners
summary: Tong will lead the firm’s newly launched Emerging Technology and AI Practice Group, helping advise government clients navigating the increasingly complex intersection of emerging technologies, artificial intelligence and public policy.

title: Connecticut enacts data privacy updates, new law inspired by California’s ‘Delete Act’
summary: Connecticut Gov. Ned Lamont signed a new law into effect on Friday that is inspired by California's popular "Delete Act."

title: Honolulu planning office uses ‘TurboTax-like’ AI tool to help applicants reduce mistakes
summary: The planning agency inside the city and county government of Honolulu is using AI tools to reduce delays and improve application quality.
